Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION FLUORESCENT MICROSCOPE WITH CAMERA-01 NOS. 1. MICROSCOPE BODY Ø Inverted trinocular microscope body with infinity-corrected optical system Ø High luminescent LED (at least 5 Watts) illumination for at least 20000 hours of usage. Ø Light distribution: 100:0 / 50:50 / 20:80 / 0:100 (Eye:Camera) Ø Eyepiece: 10X with F.O.V. 22 mm diopter adjustment facility on both eyepieces Ø Sextuple revolving nosepiece Ø Ergonomic tube Ø Universal motorized turret condenser with at least 6 positions, and phase contrast ring and capability for DIC Ø Rectangular XY motorized, scratch-proof stage with anti-corrosive coating, with universal holder to accept all specimens, slides and culture plates (round and flat-bottomed) and standard culture flasks (25 ml to 20 0 ml). Ø Microscope should be capable of fluorescence and Differential Interference Contrast imaging as per researc h requirement, with a phase slider for phase-contrast viewing and imaging. Ø Focussing: Motorized focusing with inbuilt z-resolution of 10nm or betterCompatibility: Phase contrast for 10 X, 20X and Differential Interference Contrast for 40X, 60X/63X, 100X.

Ø Nosepiece: Motorized Sextuple (six-position) revolving nosepiece with DIC slot for DIC application. 2. OBJECTIVES i. Plan 4X- High performance Plan Fluor/Apochromat for fluorescence applications. Fluorite objective suitabl e for bright field (BF) and Fluorescence (FL). ii. Long working distance Plan Fluor Phase 10X (N.A. 0.2 or better, W.D. 9 mm or more) with correction ring for BF, PH and FL. iii. Long working distance Plan Fluor Phase 20X (N.A. 0.45 or better, W.D. 7 mm or more) with correction ri ng for BF, PH and FL. iv. Long working distance Plan Fluor DIC Compatible 40X (N.A. 0.60 or better, W.D. 4 mm or more) with cor rection ring for BF, DIC and FL. v.Plan Apochromat DIC Compatible 60X/63X (N.A. 1.35/1.40 or better) with spring for BF, DIC and FL. vi. Plan Apochromat DIC Compatible 100X (N.A. 1.40 or better) oil immersion with spring for BF, DIC and FL . 3. FLUORESCENCE ATTACHMENT Ø LED module for epifluorescence for standard wavelengths used for excitation for DAPI, FITC, TRITC and Mitot racker-Red (UV to InfraRed range). Ø Lifespan should not be less than 20,000 hours. Ø Motorised at least 6-position epifluorescence turret filter block band-pass fluorescence filter for DAPI, FITC, T RITC and Mitotracker-Red. 4. CAMERA: A.Scientific grade independent microscopysCMOS camera(Monochrome)with 16-bit sCMOS sensor with high resolution and quantum efficiency of at least 80%. B. Other features: Ø Cooling: Peltier cooling upto atleast -5⁰C Ø Live display: 40 FPS at full resolution of 4K × 4K Ø USB 3.1 – PC interface Ø Pixel size 6.5 µm square or better Ø All necessary cables/power supply must be included. 5. SOFTWARE, WORKSTATION & UPS i. Automatic and interactive microscope control by single licensed software seamlessly integrated with the hardware and from the same manufacturer. ii. Suitable high-end computer system should be provided along with the microscope: Ø 64-bit Quad-Core Intel Processor Ø Minimum 64 GB DDR4 SDRAM Ø 2 TB SATA HDD (7200 RPM) Ø Support for 2 PCIe 4.0 GPUs Ø 16 GB Nvidia RTX 5000 graphics card (GDDR6 graphics memory) Ø Integrated Broadcom 5761 GbE Ethernet Controller with Remote Wake Up

Ø DVD R/W Ø Multiple USB and Firewire slots Ø Atleast28” LCD/ LED Monitor Ø Color printer iii. The running and analysis software, operating system software and (if required for the above) computer hardware should be freely upgraded as and when new versions are available for the first 5 years after insta llation. iv. A single-phase input UPS to run the system, camera and computer must be provided. v. A suitable, anti-vibration table should be provided and installed along with the microscope 6. STANDARD TERMS AND CLAUSES: i. Company must have ISO, USFDA/CE certification, (Europe/FDA/IVD) certification and a RoHs Directive d eclaration certificate and comply with international quality standard certificate. ii. User testimonials and list of users (minimum required by AIIMS) from government oragisationsshould be included iii. Companies should be willing to participate in Pre-bid meeting. iv. Microscope, objectives, XY stage, LED Fluorescence, and Imaging and analysis software should be from t he same manufacturer. v. All bidders should mandatorily give the web-links of the manufacturer’s website for the quoted microsco pe, optics, LED fluorescence, camera, software and its accessories for confirmation of compliance with ten der specifications. vi. Bidders should provide application note and citations of research papers (peer- reviewed PubMed/Scopu s indexed journals), and a copy of international/national importance institutes (Government/ private) PO for the quoted microscope, optics, camera, and software to confirm compliance with tender specifications. vii. A user list should be provided and at least three users of the same or similar model/application, preferab ly from AIIMS Delhi/NCR and Institute of National Importance, should provide a performance certificate. A u ser list should also be provided. viii. A demonstration of the setup/instrument may be requested for technical evaluation. ix. The vendor should submit an undertaking from the manufacturer regarding responsibility for maintenan ce in case of emergency or acquisition. x. Installation: Installation and two on-site operational training courses are free of cost at the installation si te. The training must cover all aspects, from general operations to relevant hardware maintenance and tro ubleshooting, as well as all software components. xi. Warranty: Warranty compliance as stipulated by the latest AIIMS GFR rules. (The complete system should have a 2-year comprehensive warranty (including spares and labor). xii. If any part isn't covered by the warranty, it should be mentioned separately in the price list of the quotat ion, as per the AIIMS Rule. xiii. Post-warranty CMC: comprehensive, including a complete list of items not covered in warranty and the ir cost of a complete system. Post-warranty CMC (8 years: 3rd - 10th years) must be as per the AIIMS Rule after completion of the warranty period with spares and labor. xiv. Prices for all spares and accessories required for the operation and maintenance of this equipment shoul d be quoted, as per AIIMS norms. .
